items.title: Activision to remove Itaewon crowd crush footage from Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 and apologises to victims' families
items.zh_title: Activision 将从《Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4》中删除梨泰院踩踏事故画面，并向遇难者家属道歉
items.summary: Activision has apologised to the bereaved families of the Itaewon crowd crush victims and confirmed it will remove real footage of the tragedy from Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. Read more
items.zh_summary: Activision 已向梨泰院踩踏事故遇难者家属道歉，并确认将从《Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4》中删除这段真实事故画面。

items.title: The Mortuary Assistant dev on laying his cancelled Paranormal Activity game to rest, resurrecting it as a Halloween freebie, and a potential return to his biggest game
items.zh_title: 《The Mortuary Assistant》开发者谈取消的《Paranormal Activity》游戏、把它复活成万圣节免费小品，以及回归代表作的可能
items.summary: Halloween feels like an especially appropriate time for Playable Archive's arrival. It's a genuinely spooky found-footage affair for one - a cleverly orchestrated 30-or-so minutes of scares from the d…
items.zh_summary: 万圣节似乎是 Playable Archive 到来的绝佳时机。这是一部真正吓人的伪纪录片式作品，约 30 分钟的惊吓经过精心编排。

items.title: Final Fantasy 14 reveals Evercold’s second new job and February release date, with pre-orders opening next week
items.zh_title: 《Final Fantasy 14》公布 Evercold 第二个新职业与 2 月发售日期，预购下周开启
items.summary: Final Fantasy 14 's next expansion, Evercold, will launch on 23rd February 2027, and its second new job is zephyr, a physical ranged DPS that fights with a crossbow and a bird. Read more
items.zh_summary: 《Final Fantasy 14》的下一个资料片 Evercold 将于 2027 年 2 月 23 日上线，第二个新职业是 zephyr，一名使用弩与飞鸟作战的物理远程 DPS。

items.title: Silent Hill: Townfall adds new Hard difficulty in latest update
items.zh_title: 《Silent Hill: Townfall》最新更新新增 Hard 难度
items.summary: Silent Hill: Townfall has added a new Hard difficulty mode and rebalanced every existing setting to make room for it. Read more
items.zh_summary: 《Silent Hill: Townfall》新增了 Hard 难度模式，并重新平衡了所有现有难度设置来为它腾出空间。

items.title: A former volunteer is threatening legal action against fan-made game project Skyblivion
items.zh_title: 一名前志愿者威胁对粉丝自制游戏项目《Skyblivion》采取法律行动
items.summary: A former volunteer is threatening legal action against Skyblivion, the long-running fan remake of Oblivion built in Skyrim's engine, over code they contributed to the project. Read more
items.zh_summary: 一名前志愿者威胁对《Skyblivion》采取法律行动，这个用《Skyrim》引擎重制《Oblivion》的长期粉丝项目，因对方贡献过的代码而陷入纠纷。

items.title: Horror-steeped card game Forbidden Solitaire shows how a strong theme can elevate even decade-old mechanics
items.zh_title: 恐怖风纸牌游戏《Forbidden Solitaire》证明，强大的主题能让十年前的老机制焕发新生
items.summary: Like a tag team of oiled snakes that have entered a wrestling contest, theme is a difficult quality to pin down. A game can be well designed, but if it lacks a coherence between those mechanics and it…
items.zh_summary: 主题是个很难拿捏的东西，游戏设计可以很好，但如果机制与美术、叙事和整体氛围不协调，就会产生割裂感，而恐怖风纸牌游戏《Forbidden Solitaire》正是靠着强烈的主题，让一套十年前的老机制重新焕发了生命力。

items.title: Silver Pines is a great survival horror throwback with an unexpected Metroidvania twist, but it makes me glad the genre's moved on
items.zh_title: 《Silver Pines》是出色的生存恐怖复古之作，带点意外的银河恶魔城风味，但也让我庆幸这个类型已经进步了
items.summary: It's those bloody typewriters all over again. Developer Wych Elm Games' Silver Pines is fantastic in a whole bunch of ways, from its woozy small-town ambience to its mix of taut survival horror and ex…
items.zh_summary: 又是那些该死的打字机。开发商 Wych Elm Games 的《Silver Pines》在很多方面都很出色，从迷离的小镇氛围，到紧张的生存恐怖与探索的结合。

items.title: What are we all playing this weekend?
items.zh_title: 这个周末大家都在玩什么？
items.summary: My scares should have been reserved for today, what with it being All Hallows' Eve and all, but my fright came on Thursday. Read more
items.zh_summary: 本来该留到万圣节前夜的惊吓，提前在周四就来了，至于这个周末大家都在玩什么，且听编辑们聊聊各自的手头游戏。

items.title: 触乐本周行业大事：10月195款游戏版号下发，《白银之城》定档，《影之刃零》正式发售，《战舰少女R》核心主创离世
items.zh_title: 触乐本周行业大事：10月195款游戏版号下发，《白银之城》定档，《影之刃零》正式发售，《战舰少女R》核心主创离世
items.summary: ■ 10月195款游戏版号下发，散爆少前新作过审，腾讯网易乐元素均在列 10月29日，国家新闻出版署公布2026年10月国产网络游戏审批信息，同步更新进口网络游戏审批信息及审批变更信息。本月共195款游戏过审，其中国产网络游戏183款、进口网络游戏12款；另有10条游戏审批变更信息同步披露。 从数量上来说，本月相较9月的209款（国产206款、进口3款）减少14款，进口版号数量明显回升。从申报类别…
items.zh_summary: 10 月共 195 款游戏下发版号，其中国产 183 款、进口 12 款，另有 10 条审批变更信息，散爆少前新作《少女前线：蓝蝶契约》过审，腾讯、网易、完美世界等头部厂商均在列，同时《白银之城》定档、《影之刃零》正式发售，《战舰少女 R》核心主创离世。

items.title: What we've been playing - "I've been intrigued by horrible images of live-action sequences for weeks"
items.zh_title: 本周在玩什么——“好几周来我一直对那些真人实拍的恐怖画面念念不忘”
items.summary: Happy Halloween! Are you scared? I am: I'm in a theatre play that opens next week and we're not ready yet. I'm also off to a ghost stories evening at the theatre tonight; I've had a few people there t…
items.zh_summary: 万圣节快乐！害怕吗？我害怕：我参演的舞台剧下周就要首演了，我们还没准备好。今晚我还要去剧院参加一个鬼故事之夜。

items.title: Team Fortress 2 Update Released
items.summary: An update to Team Fortress 2 has been released. The update will be applied automatically when you restart Team Fortress 2. The major changes include: Updated cp_wildcat_event to fix missing model for…
items.zh_summary: 《Team Fortress 2》已发布更新，重启游戏后自动应用。本次主要改动包括更新 cp_wildcat_event，修复缺失模型等问题。

items.title: Warframe's fantasy-pilled sister Soulframe finally goes open to all this November, though Digital Extremes are "nervous" about certain changes
items.zh_title: 《Warframe》的奇幻姐妹作《Soulframe》终于在 11 月向所有人开放，不过 Digital Extremes 对某些改动还有点“紧张”
items.summary: Warframe creators Digital Extremes have announced that their free-to-play fantasy RPG Soulframe will be available for everyone to download on 6th November, after two years in closed alpha. Finally, yo…
items.zh_summary: Warframe 开发商 Digital Extremes 宣布，免费奇幻 RPG《Soulframe》将在 11 月 6 日向所有玩家开放下载，结束为期两年的封闭 Alpha 测试，新一轮“公开序章”将在游戏第 17 次重大更新《Verse of the Veilands》前夕上线，届时可以将 Omen 狼崽养成可骑乘的成年狼。

items.title: GOTY hopeful Mina the Hollower bought the studio financial stability "for now," while the Shovel Knight devs work on a new 3D game
items.zh_title: 年度游戏热门《Mina the Hollower》为工作室换来了财务稳定，Shovel Knight 团队正在开发新的 3D 游戏
items.summary: Yacht Club Games has confirmed that most of its developers are now working on a brand new 3D game (potentially Shovel Knight 3D), after the critically-acclaimed Mina the Hollower did well enough for t…
items.zh_summary: Yacht Club Games 确认，大部分开发者现在正在开发一款全新的 3D 游戏（可能是《Shovel Knight 3D》），此前备受好评的《Mina the Hollower》表现足够好，为工作室带来了财务稳定。

items.title: Blizzard hints at console ports for World of Warcraft: Forever - "Play it wherever you want and, at some point, on whatever you want"
items.zh_title: Blizzard 暗示《World of Warcraft: Forever》将登陆主机：“想在哪玩就在哪玩，迟早想在什么设备上玩都行”
items.summary: After more than two decades dominating the PC MMO battlefield, it sounds like Blizzard Entertainment 's taking the idea of a World of Warcraft console port more seriously than ever. Read more
items.zh_summary: 在 PC MMO 战场称霸二十多年之后，暴雪似乎比以往任何时候都更认真地考虑把《World of Warcraft》搬上主机。

items.title: Anthropic orders AI tool Claude to stop remaking video games
items.zh_title: Anthropic 要求 AI 工具 Claude 停止重制电子游戏
items.summary: Update: Anthropic has confirmed it's released an update to Opus 5.5 to "steer" Claude Code away from "recreating someone else's specific game."
items.zh_summary: Anthropic 已确认向 Opus 5.5 发布更新，引导 Claude Code 远离“复刻别人的特定游戏”，以阻止 AI 工具被用来重制已有电子游戏。

items.title: Roblox growth slumps, but the company is betting big on AI to compensate
items.zh_title: Roblox 增长放缓，但公司押注 AI 来弥补
items.summary: Roblox's quarterly financial results missed their daily active user goals, but the company plans to make up for it somehow with AI.
items.zh_summary: Roblox 的季度财报未能达到日活用户目标，增长出现放缓，不过公司计划靠 AI 来弥补这一缺口。

items.title: Wooshy wuxia actioner Phantom Blade Zero is sharp enough on the Steam Machine, if blunted on the Steam Deck
items.zh_title: 武侠动作游戏 Phantom Blade Zero 在 Steam Machine 上表现够锐，Steam Deck 上则有些吃力
items.summary: It would appear that Phantom Blade Zero (Phantom Blade 0? Zero? Let’s go with Zero) demanding more gigs than a mismanaged stadium is doing little to stop people playing the thing. It therefore stands…
items.zh_summary: Phantom Blade Zero 体量惊人，安装包大得离谱，但这丝毫没挡住玩家的热情。既然不少人想在 Steam Machine 上玩这款 S-Game 的轻魂系武侠剑戟动作游戏，本文就实测了它在 Steam Machine 上的表现，并给出了画质设置建议。

items.title: Dark Souls 2 and Dark Souls 3's online servers are temporarily going dark, FromSoftware announces
items.zh_title: FromSoftware 宣布《Dark Souls 2》与《Dark Souls 3》在线服务器将暂时关闭
items.summary: Things might get even darker over in the world of Lordran without those silly, only sometimes helpful notes left by other players. Developer FromSoftware has announced that it's temporarily closing Da…
items.zh_summary: 没有其他玩家留下的那些傻乎乎、有时还挺有用的留言，Lordran 的世界可能会变得更黑暗。开发商 FromSoftware 宣布将暂时关闭《Dark Souls 2》与《Dark Souls 3》的在线服务器。

items.title: EA execs choosing Star Wars Battlefront 3 over Mass Effect 5 was the main factor in BioWare's demise, according to report
items.zh_title: 报道称 EA 高管选 Star Wars Battlefront 3 而非 Mass Effect 5，是 BioWare 关门的主因
items.summary: The postmortem on BioWare, following their shuttering by EA this month , points to the publisher's preference to back Star Wars Battlefront 3 over Mass Effect 5 as the main factor in the demise of the…
items.zh_summary: BioWare 本月被 EA 关闭后，关于这家深受喜爱的 RPG 工作室之死又有了新的复盘。据 Bloomberg 报道，发行商宁愿押注 Star Wars Battlefront 3 而不是 Mass Effect 5，是导致 BioWare 关门的主要原因，此外还有其他几个因素也起了作用。
